title: Sealed Glass Unit Proration and Replacement Charge Schedule — Warranty Coverage
content:
For seal failure of insulated glass, Warranty Coverage sets in each plan a proration ladder: the customer's share of the sealed-unit replacement charge, by full years since the coverage start date. Each step applies from the year it names onward.

## Proration ladder by plan

| Plan | Customer share before the step | Step | Customer share from the step onward |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 0 (none) | after 5 full years | 0.5 (one half) |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 0 (none) | after 10 full years | 0.5 (one half) |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 0 (none) | after 10 full years | 0.25 (one quarter) |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 0 (none) | no step | 0 (none) |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 0 (none) | no step | 0 (none) |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 0 (none) | no step | 0 (none) |

"From the step onward" means once that many full years have elapsed: the one-half share of the Ridgeline Limited Warranty applies once 5 full years have elapsed, and not in the fifth year itself before its anniversary.

## Published sealed-unit replacement charge

| Plan | Replacement charge per sealed glass unit (USD) |
|---|---|
| All six plans | 265.00 |

This published charge is the base a prorated share is taken of.

## What counts as seal failure

The same in every plan: **visible fogging or film between the panes that cannot be removed by cleaning.**

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Plan | Full years since coverage start | Customer share |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 4 | none |
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 5 | one half |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 9 | none |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 10 | one quarter |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 25 | none |
